results.title: Une Cite Pas Comme les Autres
results.brief_description:
La Cite Universitaire de Paris’ is made up of 37 halls of residence, housing 5000 students, 70% of whom are international students. This documentary filmed in the 1970s details the philosophy of the Cite Universitaire through interviews with past and present managers as well as residents, including Senegal President L. Senghor and Henri, Prince of Denmark.

Credits: Director, Jean-Luc Magneron ; photography, Claude Mathe.

results.title: L'ecume des Jours = the Froth of Time
results.creator_credit: Charles Belmont, Andre Michelin and Philippe Senne
results.brief_description:
Colin, a rich and sentimental young man loves Chloe. His friend Chick shares his passion for literature and neglects his girlfriend Alise. Nicolas, driver and cook, is watching over this peaceful ‘world’. Colin’s life would be perfect, if only Chloe was not suffering from a mysterious disease.

Credits: Producers, Andre Michelin, Philippe Senne ; director, Charles Belmont ; writers, Charles belmont, Philippe Dumarcay, Pierre Pelegri ; photography, Jean-Jacques Rochut ; music, Andre Hodeir.
Cast: Jacques Perrin, Marie-France Pisier, Sami Frey, Alexandra Stewart, Annie Buron, Delphine Seyrig.

results.title: sentinelle endormie = The sleeping sentry (Cinemascope Print)
results.brief_description:
In 1812, in Chalons-sur-Marne, three doctors are plotting to assassinate emperor Napoleon. But when Doctor Mathieu realises that the assassination plan may involve killing innocent by-standers, his resolve starts to crumble.

Credits: Director, Jean Dreville ; writer, Noel-Noel ; photography, Pierre Petit ; music, Georges Auric.
Cast: Noel-Noel, Pascale Audret, Michel Galabru, Francis Blanche, Micheline Luccioni, Raymond Souplex.

results.title: Rue des Prairies = Meadows Street
results.creator_credit: Denys de la Patelliere and Alexandre Mnouchkine
results.brief_description:
At the end of World War II, Henri, returns from a POW camp to his three children. Life as a widowed father proves very challenging for Henri as the children seem to either get into trouble or turn against their father.

Credits: Producer, Alexandre Mnouchkine ; director, Denys de la Patelliere ; writer, Michel Audiard ; photography, Louis Page ; music, Georges van Parys.
Cast: Marie-Jose Nat, Jean Gabin, France Asselin, Roger Dumas, Claude Brasseur, Leon Zitrone.

results.title: Les Fruits Amers = Bitter Fruits
results.creator_credit: Colette Audry, Jacqueline Audry, Guy Perol and Raymond Froment
results.brief_description:
Soledad is a member of a revolutionary group in South America. When she is arrested by government agents, she owes her release to her sister who is having an affair with the local police chief.

Credits: Producers, Raymond Froment, Guy Perol ; directors, Jacqueline Audry, Colette Audry ; writer, Colette Audry ; photography, Maurice Fellous ; music, Joseph Kosma.
Cast: Laurent Terzieff, Emmanuelle Riva, Beba Loncar, Roger Coggio, Rick Battaglia.

results.title: Le Grand Pavois
results.brief_description:
Commandant Favrel is a navy officer married to the job. His naval career is spent training young recruits on ‘La Jeanne d’Arc’ during an eight months around the world ‘trip. Tension errupts in the Favrel household when Favrel’s wife starts begging him to quit the navy and lead a ‘normal’ life. Favrel agrees to a last trip on the ‘Jeanne’ during which he will be commanding Private Hardouin, a young man courting his niece Madeleine.

Credits: Producer, Andre Paulve ; director, Jack Pinoteau ; writers, Jean Raynaud, Jack Pinoteau, Roger Vercel ; photography, Roger Arrignon ; music, Henry Verdun ; assistant director, Claude Pinoteau.
Cast: Jean Chevrier, Nicole Courcel, Marc Cassot, Marie Mansart, Jean-Pierre Mocky, Maurice Sarfaty, Jean Murat.

results.title: Nous N'irons Plus Au Bois = We Will Not Enter the Forest
results.creator_credit: Georges Dumoulin, Catherine Winter and Gisele Rebillon
results.brief_description:
During Summer 1944, a group of young people takes to the woods with orders to keep guard on four German deserters. However, Lise, a liaison agent starts a romance with Werner, one of the prisonners.

Cast: Marie-France Pisier, Siegfried Rauch, Richard Leduc, Jacques Higelin, Jacques Masson, Siegfried Rauch, Sylvain Joubert, Georges Rouquier.

results.title: Paris 1900: Chronique de 1900 a 1914
results.brief_description:
This is a montage of archival footage, newsreels and photographs evoking the political, social and artistic life of Paris at the turn of the century. The ironic tone of the narration underlines the contradiction between the sweetness of the period and the cataclysm of World War I. Personnalities appearing include: Gustave Eiffel, Marcelle Linder, Liane de Pougy, Caroline Otero, Cleo de Merode, Colette, la Comtesse d’Uzes, Buffalo Bill, Charles Pathe, Ferdinand Zecca (Pathe), Ferdinand Zecca, Andre Gide, Paul Valery, Guillaume Apollinaire, Louis Bleriot, Felix Mayol, Maurice Chevalier, Mistinguett, Polin, Sarah Bernhardt, Polaire, Jean Mounet-Sully, Leon Bonnat, Auguste Renoir, Claude Monet, Auguste Rodin, Leon Tolstoi, Jean Jaures, Aristide Briand, Leon Blum, Arthur Meyer, Maurice Barres. Includes segments from ‘Ceux de chez nous’ directed by Sacha Guitry. Reference: Forum des Images. http://www.vdp.fr

Credits: Producer, Pierre Braunberger ; director, writer, Nicole Vedres ; music, Guy Bernard ; assistant director, Alain Resnais ; editor, Yannick Bellon.
Cast: Claude Dauphin [narration].

results.title: Juliette et L'air du Temps = Juliet and the Feel of the Time
results.brief_description:
Eighteen-year old Juliette who grew up in a rural area in France has come to Paris to live. She scrapes by through begging, lives in a condemned building, and steals food occasionally at supermarkets. Her boyfriend would like her to settle down and get married, but Juliette seems to enjoy this hand-to-mouth existence.

Credits: Producer, Michel Chanderli ; director, Rene Gilson ; writer, Rene Gilson ; photography, Walter Baal ; music, Bernard Gilson.
Cast: Agnes Chateau, Jacques Zanetti, Mathieu Volta, Fabienne Arel, Janine Molinier.

results.title: L'argent des Autres = Other People's Money
results.creator_credit: Christian de Chalonge, Adolphe Viezzi, Henri Lassa and Michelle de Broca
results.brief_description:
Henri Rainier, a bank director, is unwillingly implicated in a financial fraud and laid off. Convinced he is being set up by others in the bank, he decides to investigate a number of dubious transactions and discovers a vast real estate swindle. Awards: Prix Louis Delluc, 1978 ; French Academy of Cinema (Cesars) 1978: Best Director for Christian de Chalonge, Best Film.

Credits: Producers, Michelle de Broca, Henri Lassa, Adolphe Viezzi ; director, Christian de Chalonge ; writers, Pierre Dumayet, Christian de Chalonge ; photography, Jean-Louis Picavet ; music, Patrice Mestral.
Cast: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Claude Brasseur, Michel Serrault, Catherine Deneuve, Juliet Berto, Francois Perrot.
